Type material as returned by the fetch tool in pieces and joined: 'Holotype. 'Paratypes. Nine adult females, NRC-AA1199–NRC-AA-1203, BNHS SP 402–BNHS SP 405, same locality and collection data as holotype.' Sentences around the quoted one, in printed order: 'Fovea U-shaped, deep; three striae on lateral sides of fovea, anterior stria deepest, followed by posterior and the middle respectively; caput raised, slightly more elevated than ocular area, somewhat flattened on top.' 'Ocular group longer (2.60) than wide (2.19); MOQ not square, 1.05 long, 1.00 front width, 1.11 back width.' then the quoted sentence (returned in two pieces, joined with one space), then 'Maxillae longer (3.55 anteriorly and 4.71 posteriorly) than wide (2.86), covered with bristles of variable sizes, ...' Methods (pieces returned by the fetch tool): 'All measurements are in millimetres.' 'Measurements of eyes were taken from calibrated images made under a microscope; distances between eyes, measured at narrowest points, and eye diameters were measured at the broadest points.' 'Measurements of body parts were taken consistently from the left side of each specimen with a Mitutoyo digital vernier calliper (to the nearest 0.01 mm).' The Methods define eye diameters and the quoted sentence is labelled 'Diameter', so the trait is eye_diameter_mm. Heading path as printed: the title line 'ARANEAE: IDIOPIDAE:' (family Idiopidae), genus heading 'Heligmomerus Simon, 1892', species heading 'Heligmomerus australis sp. nov.'; the page prints no separate Class heading (Araneae is the printed order). The sentence is quoted whole. Only females are described.
